class.name: JarBiome
class.brief_description: A biome of a [JarBiomeMap]: where it occurs in climate space, and its own features, details and ground materials.
class.description: A biome sits at a point in climate space ([member temperature], [member moisture]); a [JarBiomeMap] gives every position on a volume a climate and blends the biomes nearest to it. Inside a biome, its [member features] and [member details] grow (weighted by how strongly the biome is present), and the terrain shader's ground rules use its ground materials. In the default terrain shaders the first 4 biomes of a map can have their own ground materials; any number can have their own population.

members.member: Material ([member JarVoxelVolume.materials] index) for steep ground in this biome; [code]-1[/code] keeps the shader's [code]cliff_material[/code].
Details that grow in this biome, in addition to the volume's own [member JarVoxelVolume.population_terrain_details].
Features placed in this biome, in addition to the volume's own [member JarVoxelVolume.population_terrain_features]. They are placed after the volume's features, as layers in this order.
Material for flat ground in this biome; [code]-1[/code] keeps the shader's [code]ground_material[/code].
Moisture of this biome's climate point, -1 (dry) to 1 (wet).
Material for high ground (peaks) in this biome; [code]-1[/code] keeps the shader's [code]peak_material[/code].
Material under water in this biome; [code]-1[/code] keeps the shader's [code]seabed_material[/code].
Material near sea level in this biome; [code]-1[/code] keeps the shader's [code]shore_material[/code].
Temperature of this biome's climate point, -1 (cold) to 1 (hot).
